children.name: Nephrolepis
children.description: Nephrolepis — a genus of polypodiopsidas.

children.name: Nephrolepis × averyi
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Florida. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis × copelandii
children.description: The native range of this species is Taiwan, Hawaiian Is. (Hawaiʻi). It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis × hippocrepicis
children.description: The native range of this species is Nansei-shotō to Taiwan. It is a perennial or epiphyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis × medlerae
children.description: The native range of this species is as naturally occuring between the native and naturalised parents. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis × pseudobiserrata
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Nansei-shotō to Taiwan. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis abrupta
children.description: The native range of this species is W. Indian Ocean, Pen. Malaysia, Borneo. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis acutifolia
children.description: The native range of this species is Cameroon to Kenya and Mozambique, W. Indian Ocean, Indo-China to Pacific. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis arida
children.description: The native range of this species is N. Western Australia to Northern Territory.

children.name: Nephrolepis biserrata
children.description: Nephrolepis biserrata (giant swordfern, 长叶肾蕨) is a tropical fern, native to Florida, Mexico, the West Indies, Central America, South America, Africa, and southeast Asia.

children.name: Nephrolepis brownii
children.description: Nephrolepis brownii, the Asian sword fern, is a species of fern native to Asia and introduced elsewhere.

children.name: Nephrolepis cocosensis
children.description: The native range of this species is Central American Pacific Is. (Cocos I.). It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis cordifolia
children.description: Nephrolepis cordifolia is a fern native to the global tropics, including northeastern Australia and Asia.

children.name: Nephrolepis davalliae
children.description: The native range of this species is Maluku to Bismarck Arch. (New Britain). It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Nephrolepis davallioides
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Indo-China to New Guinea. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis delicatula
children.description: The native range of this species is Trop. Africa, Indian Subcontinent to Philippines. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis dicksonioides
children.description: The native range of this species is Sulawesi, New Guinea to Solomon Is.. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Nephrolepis equilatera
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Bahia).

children.name: Nephrolepis exaltata
children.description: Nephrolepis exaltata, known as the sword fern It is native to the Americas.

children.name: Nephrolepis falcata
children.description: The native range of this species is Philippines. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis falciformis
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Yunnan) to Malesia and New Guinea. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis flexuosa
children.description: The native range of this species is New Zealand, Norfolk I., SW. Pacific. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis grayumiana
children.description: The native range of this species is Costa Rica, Ecuador.

children.name: Nephrolepis hirsutula
children.description: The native range of this species is Indo-China to Pacific. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis kuroiwae
children.description: The native range of this species is Nansei-shotō.

children.name: Nephrolepis lauterbachii
children.description: The native range of this species is Maluku (Seram) to Solomon Is., N. New Caledonia. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis obliterata
children.description: Nephrolepis obliterata, the Kimberley Queen fern or Australian swordfern, is a species of fern in the family Nephrolepidaceae.

children.name: Nephrolepis obtusiloba
children.description: The native range of this species is Mexico (Veracruz, Oaxaca, Chiapas) to Bolivia. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis occidentalis
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil. It grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis pectinata
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & S. Mexico to Trop. America. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis pendula
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Mexico to Trop. America. It is a epiphyte.

children.name: Nephrolepis pickelii
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Bahia, Rio de Janeiro).

children.name: Nephrolepis radicans
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Nepal to New Caledonia. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis rivularis
children.description: The native range of this species is S. Mexico to Trop. America. It is a epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Nephrolepis undulata
children.description: The native range of this species is Trop. & Subtrop. America, Africa. It is a perennial, lithophyte or epiphyte and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
